prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: usable transparent-background illustrated game splash asset. NO TEXT.
Reference image 1 (808-cool.png): PRIMARY reference for stylized isometric drawn geometry, charcoal outlines, restrained detail, dark electronic device, amber illuminated controls. Reference image 2 (littlecottage-cozy.png): reference for handmade miniature-world charm, painterly lighting, chunky toy proportions and warm/cool color contrast. USE THESE ACTUAL REFERENCES. Do not copy their lettering or their specific subjects.
Subject: a bizarre miniature tennis world inside an OPEN portable jewel-case game console. An isometric square shell with hinged lid standing open behind a tiny green tennis court, recognizable court lines and a small net; a single oversized round yellow tennis ball hovering above the court; a few chunky amber buttons inset in the front edge. Full object isolated on true transparent background.
ART DIRECTION: hand-painted 2.5D GAME PROP, visibly illustrated, confident dark navy contours, slightly irregular hand-drawn edges, flat cel-shaded planes with 3-value lighting, broad gouache brush texture within shapes. Make the device feel lovingly sculpted and drawn rather than manufactured. Thick stylized smoky blue translucent lid represented by simple flat blue shapes and TWO broad painted reflection strokes, never raytraced glass. Chunky indigo/charcoal shell, saturated teal-green court, ochre-yellow ball and amber controls, muted violet shadows inspired by cottage twilight, warm peach rim light. Beautiful intentional shape language: rounded blocky feet, oversized rounded hinges, net reduced to readable drawn grid, buttons like thick little squares of amber. Small grassy tufts on the tiny court margins subtly tie the electronic object to the cottage diorama. Strong readable silhouette, restrained interior detail, delightful small-world scale. Illustration polished enough for an indie game asset. Entire open object within frame, 12 percent transparent margin, square composition. Perspective clean and consistent. No floor/background scene; optional tight soft painted contact shadow only beneath object.
ABSOLUTELY NO typography, letters, numbers, logos, titles, label, watermark, presentation board or mockup. No photographic lighting, realistic refraction, chrome, micro scratches, individual felt fibers, product photography, photoreal render, cinematic lens effects or shiny luxury materials. The result must be unmistakably cartoon-painted artwork, not a realistic object with a filter.
integration: Replaces realistic artwork in app and native splash. Decorative typography removed.
